paragraphs.source_zh: 听到这里，胜隆的脸有些扭曲，抱膝呜咽道：“这样的话，上总介大人只怕难逃一死。”

paragraphs.source_en: “That is precisely why the retired shogun, too, is brokenhearted.”

units.source_en: “That is precisely why the retired shogun, too, is brokenhearted.”
units.source_zh: “正因如此，大御所亦是伤心欲绝。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正因如此，大御所亦是伤心欲绝。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah! Since it is the retired shogun’s command, how can I refuse?”

units.source_en: “Ah!
Since it is the retired shogun’s command, how can I refuse?”
units.source_zh: 既然是大御所的吩咐，在下怎能拒绝。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “唉！既然是大御所的吩咐，在下怎能拒绝。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then you accept?”

units.source_en: “Then you accept?”
units.source_zh: “你愿接受了？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你愿接受了？”

paragraphs.source_en: As he spoke, Katsushige’s whole body began to convulse, and he burst into uncontrollable sobs.

units.source_en: As he spoke, Katsushige’s whole body began to convulse, and he burst into uncontrollable sobs.
units.source_zh: 说罢，胜重不由全身抽搐，大哭不止。

paragraphs.source_zh: 说罢，胜重不由全身抽搐，大哭不止。
